Mirendil raises $1B in funding to speed up AI model development. Mirendil Inc., a provider of software that speeds up artificial intelligence development, has raised $1 billion in early-stage funding. The startup stated on Thursday that Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital jointly led the Series A investment. They were joined by more than a half-dozen others including Google LLC.
